display.name: Uptime Monitoring (HTTP Check)
display.description: Synthetic uptime checks for HTTP endpoints, from the OpenTelemetry httpcheck receiver. Availability per endpoint, error text per failed probe, content validation, DNS/TCP/TLS latency, response size and certificate expiry. Filter by service.name and http.url.

display.name: Service
display.description: Collector service emitting httpcheck metrics

display.name: Endpoint
display.description: Probed HTTP endpoint (http.url)

display.name: Availability
display.description: Share of probes that returned a 2xx response

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND http.url IN $http_url AND http.status_class = '2xx'

display.name: Availability by Endpoint
display.description: Per-endpoint 2xx rate; 1 means every probe in the bucket succeeded

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND http.url IN $http_url AND http.status_class = '2xx'

display.name: Avg Response Size
display.description: Mean response body size across selected endpoints

display.name: Avg Response Time
display.description: Mean total probe duration across selected endpoints

display.name: TLS Cert Time Remaining
display.description: Seconds until certificate expiry per endpoint; only endpoints whose certificate verifies report this

display.name: Soonest Cert Expiry
display.description: Least time remaining on any verified TLS certificate

display.name: DNS Lookup Duration
display.description: Time spent resolving the endpoint hostname. Endpoints that resolve without a lookup (localhost, cached) report zero and are filtered out.

display.name: Endpoint Availability
display.description: 2xx rate per endpoint over the selected window. Endpoints with no successful probe read 0%; sort the Availability column ascending to put the worst first.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND http.url IN $http_url AND http.status_class = '2xx'

display.name: Endpoints In Error
display.description: Endpoints whose probe failed at the transport layer (DNS, connection refused, TLS rejected)

display.name: Endpoints Monitored
display.description: Number of endpoints reporting probe results

display.name: Transport Error Messages
display.description: The actual failure text per endpoint (error.message on httpcheck.error), with how many probes hit it. This is the why behind the Transport Errors count: refused connections, DNS failures, TLS verification errors.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND http.url IN $http_url AND error.message EXISTS

display.name: Response Time by Endpoint
display.description: Mean total probe duration per endpoint, slowest first

display.name: Max Response Size
display.description: Largest response body seen in the window

display.name: Non-2xx Responses by Endpoint
display.description: Probes that got an HTTP response outside 2xx, split by endpoint and status class

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND http.url IN $http_url AND http.status_class EXISTS AND http.status_class != '2xx'

display.name: Request Write Duration
display.description: Time spent writing the request to the wire

display.name: Response Read Duration
display.description: Time spent receiving the response after the request was sent

display.name: Response Size by Endpoint
display.description: Body size per endpoint; a sudden drop often means an error page replaced the real response

display.name: Status Class Distribution
display.description: Share of probe results per HTTP status class

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND http.url IN $http_url AND http.status_class EXISTS

display.name: Status Codes by Endpoint
display.description: Probe count per HTTP status code each endpoint returned in the window

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND http.url IN $http_url AND http.status_class EXISTS

display.name: TCP Connect Duration
display.description: Time to establish the transport connection

display.name: TLS Certificates
display.description: Time remaining per certificate with issuer and common name, soonest expiry first

display.name: TLS Handshake Duration
display.description: Time spent on the TLS handshake. Plain HTTP endpoints and reused connections report zero and are filtered out.

display.name: Total Response Time by Endpoint
display.description: httpcheck.duration: full probe wall time, DNS through response body

display.name: Transport Errors by Endpoint
display.description: httpcheck.error: probe never got an HTTP response (refused connection, DNS failure, TLS rejection)

display.name: Validation Failures
display.description: Total failed content assertions in the window (httpcheck.validation.failed).

display.name: Validation Failures by Endpoint and Check
display.description: Failed assertions over time, split by endpoint and validation type (contains, not_contains). Endpoints with no failures are filtered out.

display.name: Failed Content Checks
display.description: Which assertion failed, on which endpoint, how many times. Cross-check against Status Codes by Endpoint: rows here with a 2xx there are the silent failures.

display.name: Validation Pass Rate
display.description: Share of response-content assertions that passed. A 200 with the wrong body fails here while every reachability panel stays green.
